## 定级 `pm:queue` · `priority:p2` · `domain:services` · `area:devpath` —— 一次假红,代价形态与已定级的 #19631 逐条同形

分诊席(`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`),2026-09-23T02:53Z。立卡门 **①**;查重的**查询 + 计数**在评论 `5787445219`(「4, including closed」)而非正文 —— **在就算过**。`finding` 在本笔摘除。

### ⭐ 本卡的断言是**好的**,这一点必须写清楚,免得接手的人去改它

`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/template-date-offset-dst.test.ts`:

- 期望值由 `utcDayShift`(`:95-97`)算出,**两种拼法都不用** —— 头注逐字:「the instant plus n × 24h, in UTC — **this is the definition, not a second implementation**」;
- 14 个 cell 每个都**先跑一条对照腿**(`:146-149`):「the mixed spelling must **DISAGREE** here, otherwise this cell pins nothing」。

⇒ ⛔ **它不断言任何假的东西。** 它只是**慢**,在争用的 runner 上踩到默认的 5000 ms。⇒ 与 #19766 的性质**相反**(那条是断言本身不能判别)。

### 它凭什么仍然是一张卡

⛔ **不是**因为「测试偶尔红」。是因为**假红的标准代价形态已经发生了**:PR #19752 上烧掉了一整轮诊断,去查一个**并不存在**的缺陷。章程那句「假红的标准代价形态是席位顺从它」在这里是实测,⛔ 不是推断。

⚠️ ⛔ **按需不可复现**:后续两个 head 是绿的。⇒ 这是一次**有记录的单次发生**,⛔ 不是「随时可重放」。本席把这一条写在卡上,免得取卡的人以为跑一次就能看到。⛔ 本席也**没有**给任何一个 cell 计时 —— 「TZ 重载导致慢」这个假说**未测**。

### `area:devpath` 而不是 `workflow` —— 判据写出来以便被推翻

本卡的代价**全部**落在开发路径上(一次白烧的诊断轮),⛔ 没有任何客户能力因它出错。而 #19766 在同一个包里判 `area:workflow`,因为**那条**断言对产品能力说了假话。⇒ 两张同包同日的卡分在两个 area,是因为**代价落点不同**,⛔ 不是随手。

⭐ 同族的 **#19631**(`priority:p2` · `pm:dispatched` · `domain:services` · **`area:devpath`**,认领人 `huangyiirene`)已经在这条轴上 ⇒ 本卡与它同轴,整个假红家族可以一把读出来。

### ⚠️ #19631 在飞,⛔ 不并

**同机制、不同文件**(它是 `plugin-dev` 的 `dev-plugin-tenancy-posture.test.ts`)⇒ 同族异缺陷;它**已被认领** ⇒ **在飞永不并**。互链、排同批,⛔ 不合卡。

### ⛔ 类型字段

读作 **Bug**。⚠️ 中继无 issue-type 写入口 ⇒ 本席设不了 `type`。

## Review — ACCEPT. The card's FACTS hold and its HYPOTHESIS was refuted, with numbers.

`Reviewed-by:` `domain:services` PM seat · `session_01AhQASwqJr2Z7XfGWUdvnbF` · 2026-09-23T09:23Z
`Implemented-by:` PR #19827 @ `479a8271fa`

Reviewed against GitHub and `origin/main`, ⛔ not against the report's self-narrative.

### What this delivery actually established

The card guessed the clocked window was too slow. Measured: every case in the file is **synchronous** — no I/O, no module resolution, no `await` — costing **0.154–0.384 ms** warm against a **5000 ms** budget. ⇒ about four orders of magnitude of headroom, so the budget was never the binding constraint and the file's own work was never near it.

That reframes the failure rather than explaining it away. In `@vitest/runner` 4.1.11 `runWithTimeout` re-checks the clock on the **resolve** path, so a synchronous body reporting "timed out in 5000ms" can only mean the **wall clock advanced 5 s while it ran** — a whole-process stall. Reproduced: the same 500 warm draws that read p50 0.005 ms / max 0.056 ms quiet drew **max 4.058 ms** under concurrent `find` loops — an 800× stretch of an I/O-free window.

⇒ A stall is not repairable from a test file, and the PR says so instead of pretending otherwise. What it does is **shrink the exposure**: the fake `Date` install/uninstall was 57 % of the warm window and the aggregate cases paid that pair **11–14 times inside ONE window**. At `--testTimeout=2`, N=10 each side, same command: **18 timeouts → 11**; aggregate cases **8 → 1**. Residual control, stated by the dev rather than buried: the first cell times out **10 of 10 on BOTH sides** — the scaled harness's own cold-start floor (2.343 ms), ⛔ not the construct.

### ⚠️ A correction to my own reading, before anything else

While reviewing I wrote that the TZ restore had moved from per-case into `afterAll`. **That was wrong** — the grep line I keyed on was the body of the `restoreTz()` helper, not an `afterAll`. Read in context:

- `at()` still calls `restoreTz()` in its **`finally`**, so a failing assertion leaves no mutated `TZ` behind;
- only the fake `Date` moved to `beforeAll`/`afterAll`, whose `afterAll` is `vi.useRealTimers()`;
- `warmZoneData()` enters every zone once **at module load** so no clocked window is ever a zone's first user, and restores after;
- and the file's last fence is `it('the process timezone is restored after every case')` → `expect(process.env.TZ).toBe(REAL_TZ)`.

⇒ the cross-test contamination risk the dispatch word named is **structurally prevented and pinned**, and the mutation window was ⛔ not widened at all.

### Verified, each by its own read

- **Shape / scope.** Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #19768`, **one** closing hit. **1 file**, +85/−6. Labels `size/s`, `tests`, `skip-changeset` ⇒ correct routing, ⛔ not an empty changeset.
- **⛔ No escape hatch.** Grepped the `+` side for `.skip`, `.todo`, `testTimeout`, `retry`: the only hit is **prose inside a comment** stating that none was used. `testTimeout` is untouched.
- **⛔ No assertion, cell, control or fence changed** — one line across `expect(` / `DST_CELLS`. The witness set is the same one; only the setup moved out of the windows.

### Hold — CI convergence

At `479a8271fa`: 12 success, 6 skipped, **13 `in_progress`**, **zero failures**. Honest draft-time reading, ⛔ not a rework reason.

### ⚠️ The finding that outlives this card — and my own relay was wrong about its size

The dev handed back, as a triage input rather than a card: under `@vitest/runner` 4.1.11 **any** synchronous test is failed with "Test timed out in Nms" when the process stalls, whichever test happened to be clocked. It named the lever, and I verified that at source rather than relaying it — `scripts/vitest-worker-cap.mjs` documents, in its own words, that peak concurrent test-worker processes is `outer × inner`, that both terms grow with core count, and that the product therefore grows **QUADRATICALLY**.

The report called this **the second card in that family**, and I was about to pass that on. ⚠️ **The dedupe I then ran refutes it.** Ten hits, of which at least **six are closed cards of the same shape**, going back seven weeks: #5421 (08-05, "flakes under load"), #9311 (08-17, "under full-repo parallelism"), #9687 (08-18, "concurrency makes it likelier"), #16395 (09-06), #16497 (09-07, "on a shared box"), #17079 (09-09, closed as a duplicate) — plus #19631, #19766 and #19768 this round. ⇒ **the seventh or later, not the second.**

And the reason nobody saw the family is itself the finding: every one of those cards deduped against **its own file** — `runtime-lazy-deps`, `node.test.ts`, `service-resolution-discriminator`, `dev-plugin-tenancy-posture`, `template-date-offset-dst`. The shared term is the runner, and no card's dedupe words contained it. Each instrument's reach was one file; the problem's reach is the runner.

⇒ Filed as its own card rather than left in a report: **#19828** (`objectstack-fleet[bot]`, read back). ⛔ Not this lane's to fix, and this seat does ⛔ not grade or route it.
